notes.title: Big System Update
notes.content:
We have repaired most / all of our wallpaper systems.

Wallpaper design turned out to be something more difficult than we thought. Animated wallpapers for Windows 10 require some system settings. Despite many of our messages, someone still missed them and problems began.

After many tries, it's Big System update is ready. Most problems have probably been fixed.

90% of negative reviews describe what has been fixed:

-I can't control the wallpaper
-I can't turn off the wallpaper
-I can't uninstall this wallpaper
-My menu disappear
-Where is Taskbar to enable the second menu?
-The wallpaper is in window
-False antivirus alert
-Problem with Inputapp.exe process
-3DM website runs on my screen
-Wallpaper won't pause when I start the game
-and more

These problems should be fixed now!

In addition, the new system recognizes if the Windows 10 settings are not correct. After detecting, the wallpaper will automatically change them or show you a video on how to set it. The wallpaper itself will open a window to change the settings to "adjust the best appearance", then click the green "DONE".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33639162/cae73aecef41355cba292522b764ea27aa909939.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33639162/efea90b7df85eb47b84467571d2a7c1534e0d207.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33639162/a724a0c02d5bedf82babbd8c02229aef60e9b123.jpg[/img]


There are more patches but the competition is not sleeping so we will keep them to ourselves.

The user with the correct settings will not see the difference at the beginning but in the end, the project will work much better with it.

We are very pleased that finally, we have created the system with which we are satisfied.

Everything has been tested on many PCs and everything works as it should. If you have any problems, please write below. We will fix immediately.

Some programs may still block our projects, but this is very, very rare.

Please update our project and enjoy!

I would also like to apologize to those who had problems with the settings. Creating wallpaper requires certain technologies but now everything should play.

Thank you also for the support of our users. Your suggestions have helped us a lot and today you can see the effects. Thanks.

Best Regards,

3DM

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33639162/15fc97929f0d1281d3de22dd2bc9467c6f85d1e8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Update for 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33639162/4012401a11bea45f429472185072bac5a178d99f.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone ;D

Today we have an update for our Earth. This should eliminate most of the common problems.

The first run will show you System Check window to test your Windows 10 settings. With any problems please set this https://imgur.com/a/S6QFr9t.

Then you can select your language and screens. In the end, you will be able to place the menu icon where you want.

Also, there is a new icon on taskbar (next to your clock, speaker, wifi icons). From this Earth icon, you can open the menu or change its place....and close wallpaper.

This should eliminate a problem with "missing" menu icon on wallpaper.

[b][u]Now you can disconnect from Steam to keep wallpaper invisible for your Steam friends. (Steam Support trigger in the menu). [/u][/b][b]To disconnect you have to restart wallpaper.[/b]

Few other little tweaks have been made to eliminate bugs.

I have to say...this wallpaper is great and was really nice to see again the Earth on my screen ;D

Please let me know with any problems ;D Thanks

3DM

notes.title: Display Selector is ready!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33639162/7a1549cf7f097c2aa65a0573b19c99d9c241ba95.jpg[/img]

Many users with many screens asked for features to select only one screen to display our project. It was our priority to add such a possibility.

[b] It works after a big fight with the Windows code! [/b]

When you start the wallpaper for the first time, a window is displayed where you can select the detected screen. The same function is available in the menu if someone wants to change the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33639162/828dce50c005576ba4a1b1d7f4939c8b9298fba4.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Attention[/h1][/b]

Unfortunately, after this update, you will probably lose your background settings. We are sorry :( :( :(

If you do not see any new features (probably the automatic update is disabled), you should uninstall the wallpaper and reinstall it.

[h1]It's not all.[/h1]

We have added the "Auto Game Mode" which automatically pauses the wallpaper when you turn on the normal game full screen. It automatically gives you 100% of your PC's performance for your favourite games.

The wallpaper recognizes another application / the game is in full-screen mode and then turns off. When you turn off the game, the wallpaper automatically appears on your screens.


[b][h1]Attention[/h1][/b]

Some games do not turn on "real" full-screen mode, so our wallpaper does not turn off. Before you turn on such a game, you need to press the "GAMEMODE" button on the background image itself to get 100% power.

[b] Thank you for your support. Thanks to you, we are constantly developing our projects. [/b]

[i][b] 3DM [/b] [/i]

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33639162/f974dd4f4b3f329a20811aca296cdc47c615c40b.jpg[/img]

Heyyy, :D

We have prepared some tweaks for "the Earth". We found a bug that has been repaired. By the way, we have added a new camera mode that follows the ISS International Space Station.

notes.title: First Weeks Summary
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33639162/b214a7c1d053e837c4a93a4b5bcb90295e713e85.jpg[/img]

From the beginning of the release of our wallpaper, we have published three updates in which we repaired the errors you reported. Thank you for that.

Here's a list of recent changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed controls and menu
[*] Improved Startup system to work every time.
[*] Added Game Mode button to play a game. When you finish your game, get back to your new wallpaper.
[*] Fixed Mouse input.
[*] Added draggable menu
[*] Removed feature "freeze" (was useless)
[*] Updated icons
[*] and more
[/list]

You can read all the changes on the main page of this project.

Some users suggest that the wallpaper contains a Trojan, which is not true. As this is a wallpaper and must be visible under the windows and icons then we need to cheat the Windows system a bit. Small anti-virus programs sometimes read this as an attack but it is not really.

We encourage everyone to evaluate our project, unfortunately, most often it happens when something goes wrong.

We are very grateful for your help.

Of course, there will be more updates ;D

btw. we are close to completing a new project which will soon be published on Steam. ;) stay tuned.

Enjoy your flight!

3DM

notes.title: UPDATES: Multi-Screen Menu Support!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33639162/e7bb0447c2250bbca3a7c313eff4dd2bad4a0d5a.jpg[/img]

Some users with multiple screens have problems accessing the menu. Different resolutions caused the menu to appear out of the screen. We added the Drag & Drop function so that everyone could determine the location of the menu.

[list]
[*] Added draggable menu
[*] Removed feature "freeze" (was useless)
[*] Updated icons 
[/list]

[b]Info for multi-screen.[/b]
For the best look set the earth position at one side (left/right) to keep the earth on one screen.

more updates soon...

[b]Enjoy your flight![/b]

 [list]

    [*]Improved Startup system to work every time.
    [*]Added Game Mode button to pause wallpaper when you want to play a game. When you finish your game you can get back to your new wallpaper.
